**Travel Advice**
Event attendees are responsible for all travel-related costs and should book their travel directly.


**Attire**
Business casual is recommended. Please remember to bring a sweater or light jacket as the meeting rooms may be cool.


**Event Contact**
Should you have any questions or need immediate support either onsite or prior to attending the Executive Partner Meeting, please contact Elisa Jannasch via email atelisa.jannasch@3dsystems.com or via mobile at +49 176 723 13 603.


**Space is Limited- Reserve Your Spot Today!**
Join us at the Executive Partner Event to gain the insights, tools, and connections needed to accelerate your business growth. We look forward to working with you to shape the future of additive manufacturing.
